# HcmDZ — Android Developer

> Native Android apps (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3). English, French, Arabic with RTL support.

## Apps

- [ElecPilot](https://hcmdz.github.io/elecpilot/) — motor starters and PLC I/O manager. Offline-first, encrypted cloud backup, Excel/CSV.
  Source and releases: <https://github.com/Hcmdz/ElecPilot>
- [OpenCode Free Radar](https://hcmdz.github.io/opencode-free-radar/) — tracks AI models free to use with OpenCode, with freebie alerts.
  Source and releases: <https://github.com/Hcmdz/OpenCode-Free-Radar>
- [Privnum](https://hcmdz.github.io/Privnum/) — private on-device caller ID. Zero network permissions, VCF backup.
  Source and releases: <https://github.com/Hcmdz/Privnum>
